# braintrust_project_automation (Resource)

Manages a Braintrust project automation rule. Automations allow you to set up alerts (webhook or Slack), scheduled data exports, data retention policies, and environment-update notifications for a project.

Exactly one of `logs_config`, `export_config`, `retention_config`, or `environment_update_config` must be specified.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the project automation.
- `project_id` (String) The project this automation belongs to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Textual description of the project automation.
- `environment_update_config` (Attributes) Notify when an environment is updated. Exactly one of webhook_action or slack_action must be specified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environment_update_config))
- `export_config` (Attributes) Schedule periodic data exports to cloud storage (e.g. S3). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--export_config))
- `logs_config` (Attributes) Alert when log events match a BTQL filter. Exactly one of webhook_action or slack_action must be specified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logs_config))
- `retention_config` (Attributes) Set a data retention policy for the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--retention_config))

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of creation.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the project automation.
- `user_id` (String) The user who created this automation.

<a id="nestedatt--environment_update_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environment_update_config`

Optional:

- `environment_filter` (List of String) Optional list of environment slugs to filter by. If empty, all environments trigger the action.
- `slack_action` (Attributes) Post a message to a Slack channel when the automation triggers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environment_update_config--slack_action))
- `webhook_action` (Attributes) Send an HTTP POST to a webhook URL when the automation triggers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environment_update_config--webhook_action))

<a id="nestedatt--environment_update_config--slack_action"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environment_update_config.slack_action`

Required:

- `channel` (String) The Slack channel ID to post to.
- `workspace_id` (String) The Slack workspace ID.

Optional:

- `message_template` (String) Custom message template for the alert.


<a id="nestedatt--environment_update_config--webhook_action"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environment_update_config.webhook_action`

Required:

- `url` (String) The webhook URL to send the request to.



<a id="nestedatt--export_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `export_config`

Required:

- `export_path` (String) Storage path including protocol, e.g. "s3://bucket/prefix".
- `export_type` (String) What to export: "log_traces", "log_spans", or "btql_query".
- `format` (String) Export format: "jsonl" or "parquet".
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Export interval in seconds (1–2592000).

Optional:

- `aws_iam_credentials` (Attributes) AWS IAM role credentials for cross-account S3 access. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--export_config--aws_iam_credentials))
- `batch_size` (Number) Number of rows to export in each batch.
- `btql_query` (String) The BTQL query to export. Required when export_type is "btql_query".

<a id="nestedatt--export_config--aws_iam_credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `export_config.aws_iam_credentials`

Required:

- `role_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM role to assume.

Optional:

- `external_id` (String) The external ID for the role trust policy. Auto-generated if omitted.



<a id="nestedatt--logs_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logs_config`

Required:

- `btql_filter` (String) BTQL filter expression to match log rows.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Fire the action at most once per this many seconds (1–2592000).

Optional:

- `slack_action` (Attributes) Post a message to a Slack channel when the automation triggers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logs_config--slack_action))
- `webhook_action` (Attributes) Send an HTTP POST to a webhook URL when the automation triggers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logs_config--webhook_action))

<a id="nestedatt--logs_config--slack_action"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logs_config.slack_action`

Required:

- `channel` (String) The Slack channel ID to post to.
- `workspace_id` (String) The Slack workspace ID.

Optional:

- `message_template` (String) Custom message template for the alert.


<a id="nestedatt--logs_config--webhook_action"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logs_config.webhook_action`

Required:

- `url` (String) The webhook URL to send the request to.



<a id="nestedatt--retention_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retention_config`

Required:

- `object_type` (String) The type of data to apply retention to: "project_logs", "experiment", or "dataset".
- `retention_days` (Number) Number of days to retain data. 0 means delete immediately.
